problem: A phone followed by a list marker ("415-555-0199 1.", " 2)", " 3 -") is dropped: the greedy sticky match swallows the marker digits and the verdict rejects the run.
impact: A phone number stays readable in redacted output.
suggested_fix: Retry the baseline end, then whitespace-cut prefixes, in the phone scanner.
evidence: Reported in round 6 against 9d4cbc36 (PR 916). Fixed in PR 918 (merge 05ce8851).

sites: src/security/detect/pii.ts: phoneScanner / execPhone (sticky phone scan, end selection)
class_scope.enumeration_method: Every phone-match end selection in pii.ts: the baseline end in the sticky scan and the rescan window end; the list-marker shapes ("1.", "2)", "3 -") and the separators - . space were tried against both, and the same shapes were run through the 120,000-input differential against baseline 6f6d8898.

verification.evidence: Checked at 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611. At 05ce8851 detectPii reports pii.phone[5,17) "415-555-0199" for "call 415-555-0199 2) next item", "... 3 - next item", "call 415.555.0199 1) next item", "call 415 555 0199 2) next item" and "call 415-555-0199 1. 2) next item"; applyRedaction gives "call [REDACTED:phone] 2) next item". The reviewed head 9d4cbc36 returned no span for these. Baseline 6f6d8898 caught only the "1." and newline forms, so the regression holds only against 9d4cbc36. Coverage check: 120,000 random phone, card, SSN, email and list-marker inputs, baseline 6f6d8898 reported 90,906 spans and every one is still covered by a same-rule span at 05ce8851 (0 misses).

disposition.evidence: fixed in PR 918, merge commit 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611 (branch fix/pii-round6-fixes); review-verifier refuted the finding by execution at 05ce8851

problem: Overlapping spans from the plain and NFKC passes cause double masks.
impact: Redacted output carries two markers or a partial leftover.
suggested_fix: Coalesce same-rule spans; make applyRedaction mask a partial overlap with the marker already written.
evidence: Reported in round 6 against 9d4cbc36 (PR 916). Fixed in PR 918 (merge 05ce8851).

verification.evidence: Checked at 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611. At 05ce8851 "call 415-555-019\uFF19" yields one pii.phone[5,17) and redacts to "call [REDACTED:phone]"; 9d4cbc36 returned two overlapping spans phone[5,17) and phone[5,16). applyRedaction on overlapping phone/card spans leaves no digit and one marker.

disposition.evidence: fixed in PR 918, merge commit 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611 (branch fix/pii-round6-fixes); review-verifier refuted the finding by execution at 05ce8851

problem: rescanPhoneRun builds false phone windows inside card, ID and table runs.
suggested_fix: Require separator evidence, anchor at a run start, never cross a line break or a 2+ space gap, drop windows overlapping a Luhn-valid card.
evidence: Reported in round 6 against 9d4cbc36 (PR 916). Fixed in PR 918 (merge 05ce8851).

verification.evidence: Checked at 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611. At 05ce8851 "ref 1234 5678 9012 3456 end", "id 123 456 789 012 345 678 end", the table row "totals   12   12    0 ..." and "a 1 2 3 ... 12" give no phone span; "4111 1111 1111 1111" gives only the card. 9d4cbc36 gave phone[4,18) and phone[3,22) for the first two.

disposition.evidence: fixed in PR 918, merge commit 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611 (branch fix/pii-round6-fixes); review-verifier refuted the finding by execution at 05ce8851

problem: An unclosed describe in pii-normalised.test.ts, and the phone scanner pending queue is not reset at scan start.
impact: State can leak between scans after an aborted scan.
suggested_fix: Close the describe; reset the scanner at scan start.
evidence: Reported in round 6 against 9d4cbc36 (PR 916). Fixed in PR 918 (merge 05ce8851).

verification.evidence: Checked at 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611. At 05ce8851 pii-normalised.test.ts has four describe blocks and four closing "});"; the 8 PII test files run 171 pass, 0 fail. phoneScanner.reset() clears pending, cursor, runEnd, runBaseline and tailEnd and detectPii calls rule.regex.reset?.() at scan start (pii.ts:860); checked by reading only, since an aborted scan cannot be triggered from outside.

disposition.evidence: fixed in PR 918, merge commit 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611 (branch fix/pii-round6-fixes); review-verifier refuted the finding by execution at 05ce8851

problem: A hyphen- or dot-joined phone followed by more digits is not reported ("415-555-0199-123456", "415.555.0199.415.555.0199").
impact: The number stays readable in redacted output. Pre-existing in baseline 6f6d8898.
suggested_fix: Split over-long runs on hyphen and dot, not only whitespace.
evidence: Reported in round 6 against 9d4cbc36 (PR 916). Deferred to flow 412 by operator poll 113.

verification.evidence: Checked at 05ce88515a820cd6e185d320fef74cd3b34f6611. At 05ce8851 "415-555-0199-123456" and "415.555.0199.415.555.0199" return no spans and redact to themselves; baseline 6f6d8898 also returned none, so it is pre-existing and unfixed (deferred to flow 412).

disposition.evidence: operator decision, poll 113 (2026-10-07): pre-existing in baseline 6f6d8898, tracked in flow 412 (PII detector: separator and glue misses); review-verifier confirmed it still reproduces at 05ce8851
